## Format

`YYYY-MM-DD [HH:MM] | what happened | provenance | notes`

Provenance: `документ / documented` · `со слов / reported` · `на фото / seen in photo` · `примерно / estimated` · `неизвестно / unknown`.
Measurements carry their units.
